message:
The other day, we found ourselves digging through our emergency supplies and stumbled upon some old board games that had been gathering dust. It was a delightful surprise! Instead of scrolling through screens, we decided to have a family game night, complete with snacks and lots of laughter. 

It reminded us that preparedness doesn’t just mean stocking up on supplies; it also means finding joy in the simple moments together. Rediscovering low-tech fun can be just as important as having a go-bag ready. What’s one low-tech activity you’ve enjoyed lately? 😊
